overall_assessment: Section boundaries are mostly right (arbeidskrav correctly in coursework_requirements, exam text in assessment, no leakage of the flagged kind). Main defects: the course metadata table is prepended to learning_outcomes, some LO bullets and whole deleksamen lines are dropped, and Innhold sub-themes that follow a page break or are named 'arbeidsmåter' are filed as teaching_methods. All six pre-pass 'leak->' flags are false alarms (words like vurderingsformer/pensum inside ordinary text).

findings.evidence: Studieprogrammet emnet inngår i    Steinerpedagogisk lærerutdanning med bachelorgrad
findings.description: The metadata table at the top of the plan (Emnekode og emnenavn, Engelsk emnenavn, Studieprogrammet, Studiepoeng, Semester, Undervisningsspråk) is prepended to learning_outcomes in the PEL courses (PEL1.1-1.5), i.e. admin/metadata text in a section that should hold only outcomes. The MAT/NAT/NOR courses are clean, so it depends on the plan layout (no blank-line/title before the table).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Plans for PEL courses have no title line separating the metadata table from Læringsutbytte; the extractor starts learning_outcomes at the start of the document (preamble before the first recognised heading is assigned to the first section).
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections()/steiner strategy, drop the preamble before the first heading (or strip lines beginning 'Emnekode og ', 'Emnenavn', 'Engelsk emnenavn', 'Studieprogrammet emnet inngår i', 'Studiepoeng', 'Semester', 'Undervisningsspråk' with their continuation lines).

findings.evidence: •     har kunnskap om forholdet mellom identitet, livssyn og verdier hos elever
findings.description: Individual learning-outcome bullets present in the plan are missing from the extracted section: the first Kunnskap bullet in M-PEL1_2 ('forholdet mellom identitet...') and M-PEL1_1 ('skolens formål og demokratiske mandat'), and 'har kunnskap om geometriske grunnbegreper' in M-MAT1_1. The other bullets survive, so outcomes are silently incomplete.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Line-level cleanup in extract_sections.R (.clean_sections or the steiner splitter) removes some lines adjacent to the Kunnskap/Studenten sub-headings or blank lines (probably a heading-strip regex matching 'Kunnskap'-initial lines or eating the first line after the 'Studenten' label).
findings.suggested_fix: Restrict sub-heading stripping to lines that exactly equal 'Kunnskap', 'Ferdigheter', 'Generell kompetanse' (anchored ^...$), and do not drop content lines starting with bullets or 'har kunnskap'. Add a regression test comparing bullet counts with the source plan.

findings.description: Content that belongs to Innhold (course_content) is emitted as teaching_methods: the last Innhold bullet after a page break in M-MAT1_1, 'Tema 4: Estetiske arbeidsmåter' (musikk, språkforming) in M-PEL1_3, and 'Tema 3: Praktisk-estetiske arbeidsmåter' (formtegning, eurytmi) in M-MAT1_2. These are topics, not the teaching-method description; course_content is left incomplete. In M-MAT1_1 it is just a page-break artefact.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading map matches 'arbeidsmåter' (Tema N: ...arbeidsmåter) inside Innhold as a teaching_methods heading; in M-MAT1_1 the page number '10' seems to break the Innhold block so the remainder is mis-assigned.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/section_heading_map.R only match 'Arbeidsmåter' / 'Undervisnings- og arbeidsformer' as teaching_methods when the line is the whole heading (^Arbeidsmåter$), not 'Tema N: ...'. Remove stand-alone page-number lines before heading detection so blocks aren't split.

findings.evidence: Deleksamen 2: Individuell skriftlig eksamen under tilsyn.
findings.description: Lines introducing the second part-exam are lost: in M-NOR1_3 the assessment keeps only 'Varighet: 6 timer.' without the 'Deleksamen 2: Individuell skriftlig eksamen under tilsyn.' line; in M-MAT1_2 'Deleksamen 2. Individuell muntlig eksamen. Varighet 20-30 minutter.' is absent entirely. The form of the second exam is therefore unrecoverable.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sub-heading stripping in assessment removes lines starting with 'Deleksamen 2' (treated like the 'Eksamensform' label) or lines that look like sub-headings; drops the whole line, not only the label.
findings.suggested_fix: When removing the 'Eksamensform/Hjelpemidler/Sensorordning/Vurderingsuttrykk' labels, remove only exact label lines; keep any line carrying content after the label (e.g. starting 'Deleksamen').

findings.description: Assessment mixes exam form with logistics (aids, sensor arrangement, grading scale, ny/utsatt eksamen). The sub-heading labels are stripped inconsistently: 'Sensorordning' remains while 'Eksamensform', 'Hjelpemidler', 'Vurderingsuttrykk' and 'Ny/utsatt eksamen' are removed, leaving unlabelled orphan sentences such as 'Bestått / Ikke bestått.'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Steiner sub-heading list in the cleaning step lacks 'Sensorordning' (and does not drop the logistics blocks).
findings.suggested_fix: Either strip all five exam sub-headings consistently (add 'Sensorordning'), or better keep all labels; optionally drop Sensorordning/Hjelpemidler/Ny-utsatt blocks from assessment as exam logistics.

findings.description: PDF page numbers (bare integers such as 9, 10, 12, 13, 17, 18) remain as lines inside learning_outcomes, course_content, coursework_requirements and assessment, sometimes splitting a bullet list.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source text comes from PDF; no rule removes lines consisting only of digits.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() remove lines matching ^\s*\d{1,3}\s*$ before splitting and for all sections.

findings.description: In M-NOR1_3 two arbeidskrav titles ('Arbeidskrav om muntlige arbeidsformer og arbeid med drama' and 'Litterær samtale (muntlig arbeidskrav)') are dropped, leaving untitled paragraphs that cannot be attributed to a named requirement. Content is otherwise correctly placed in coursework_requirements, and generic admission/right-to-exam intro text is also included.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Lines containing 'arbeidskrav'/'muntlig' matched as a section heading and stripped.
findings.suggested_fix: Only strip the exact section heading line 'Arbeidskrav' (anchored) and keep sub-titles.
